name: half kneeling pvc pec mobilization stretch
description: A chest opener using a PVC pipe from a half-kneeling position. It loosens tight pecs and the front of the shoulder.
instructions: Take a half-kneeling stance and hold a light PVC pipe horizontally with a wide, comfortable grip.
Keep your hips stable and gently rotate your upper body away from the side you want to stretch.
Let the pipe guide your arms without forcing the shoulder, until you feel a mild stretch across the chest.
Hold briefly, return to center and switch sides.
